text:
maria: FYI scheduling a coordinated rollout during the Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need a quick agreement on order, pins, and rollback triggers. API, Runtime, Router, Console all touched.

joan: ack. Runtime can push v2.4.1 (fixed KV eviction) but we must keep `kernel_batching=false` until router change is live.

raj: router ack. There's a small route header change (x-rw-route -> x-rw-model) in API v3.0.2; router needs config to map old header during canary. I can do a staged flip.

maria: plan proposal: 1) Router config (canary 5%) 2) API v3.0.2 canary traffic 3) Runtime v2.4.1 rollout (gradual) 4) Console patch deploy. Thoughts?

liam: +1 on staged. Add a safety hold between API canary and runtime so we can validate 200s and latencies for 15m. Also request a metric to check KV hit-rate after runtime change.

joan: agree to 15m hold. We'll enable runtime flags behind `runtime_release/172999` feature gate so we can roll back fast.

raj: router will accept both headers for the canary. After runtime is stable, we'll flip mapping and remove legacy header in a later window.

maria: rollback criteria proposed: sustained 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >200ms for 10m. If triggered, run coordinated rollback: revert API traffic split, pin runtime back to prior sha, revert router mapping.

liam: +1. I'll prepare runbook snippets. Quick note: on rollback we should also revoke canary tokens so console users don't hit mixed behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-172999-01, components=[router,api,runtime,console], change_window=2026-04-07T02:00:00Z..2026-04-07T04:00:00Z. See CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/172999-01

maria: release notes draft linked: https://docs.redwood.example/release-notes/172999. Includes API schema change, runtime KV fix, console minor UI. Please review.

joan: one more: kernel patch in runtime requires a later kernel rollout on dedicated; we'll mark that in the notes and include compatibility matrix.

raj: router can run the canary at 5% for 30m, then 25% for 15m, then 100% if stable. If any 5xx spike, immediate pause and call handoff.

liam: SRE oncall will monitor metrics: api_5xx_rate, router_errors, runtime_kv_miss, p95_latency. Alert policy: severity P1 if >0.5% 5xx or p95>300ms.

sre-oncall: I'll be on call for the window. Slack channel #incidents will be used for post-mortem if needed.

maria: final checks: owners ack? joan/raj/liam say go?

joan: go for runtime, will keep gate.

raj: go for router config.

liam: go from SRE side.

deploy-bot: deploy started: router canary -> ok, 5% healthy.

deploy-bot: deploy notice: api canary rollout started (10% traffic).

liam: watching metrics. so far 0.02% 5xx, p95 +10ms.

deploy-bot: runtime rollout started (gradual 10% steps).

deploy-bot: console patch deployed to web nodes 3/3.

maria: copy — monitoring the hold window. If stable at 30m we'll proceed to full flip.

deploy-bot: canary -> 25% router mapping flip completed.

sre-oncall: after 40m looks clear. no alerts. ready to proceed to full rollout in 10m.

maria: proceeding to full rollout. please hold any dev pushes until tomorrow.

deploy-bot: full rollout complete. All components at target versions.

liam: post-deploy checks: KV hit-rate returned to baseline, p95 within +15ms. No 5xx spikes.

joan: runtime kernel flag remains off for now; create ticket to enable next week when dedicated kernel patch lands.

maria: excellent. I'll merge release notes and close the release ticket. Thank you all :tada:
